xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheAuthority: Court of the Additional District Collector (City), Meerut, Uttar Pradesh
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: The authority has imposed a penalty of Rs.15,000/-.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: The Food Safety Officer collected a sample of Shahi Tukda from the Company’s restaurant at Pinnacle Tower, Meerut. On laboratory testing, the sample was found to contain the synthetic food colour Tartrazine. However, the same was not disclosed in Form VI as part of the ingredients, which was considered misleading to consumers, and accordingly, the product was held to be misbranded.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: There is no material impact on the financial, operation or other activities of the Company, except to the extent of imposition of penalty of Rs.15,000/-.

xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: The Food Safety Officer collected a sample of Chocolate Pastry from the Company’s restaurant at Pinnacle Tower, Meerut. On laboratory testing, the Butyro-Refractometer (BR) value of the extracted fat at 40°C was found to be below the minimum prescribed limit for refined soybean oil declared as an ingredient, and accordingly, the sample was held to be sub-standard.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: There is no material impact on the financial, operation or other activities of the Company, except to the extent of imposition of penalty of Rs.15,000/-.
